title: Weaken to Strengthen: Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.38681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-distillation offers a way to improve reasoning models when a suitable external teacher is unavailable. However, common approaches rely on privileged information to construct a stronger self-teacher, limiting their use when only unlabeled prompts are available. In this paper, we introduce Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation (WISD), which instead constructs a weaker counterpart of the original model and uses the contrast between the two as a training signal without requiring privileged information. We explore two ways to construct the weaker model: low-bit quantization and magnitude pruning. We evaluate WISD across diverse architectures and scales on mathematical and coding reasoning tasks. Across these benchmarks, quantization and pruning improve average accuracy over the original models by 4.0 and 5.5 percentage points, respectively, achieving state-of-the-art performance even without privileged information. translated_title: 以弱致强：面向大型推理模型的弱化诱导在策略自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 自蒸馏为在缺乏合适外部教师的情况下改进推理模型提供了一种途径。然而，常见方法依赖于特权信息来构建更强的自教师模型，这限制了它们在仅有无标注提示可用时的应用。本文提出了弱化诱导在策略自蒸馏（WISD），该方法转而构建原始模型的一个弱化版本，并利用两者之间的对比作为训练信号，无需任何特权信息。我们探索了两种构建弱化模型的方式：低位量化与幅度剪枝。我们在数学与编程推理任务上，跨多种架构和规模对WISD进行了评估。在这些基准测试中，量化与剪枝分别使原始模型的平均准确率提升了4.0和5.5个百分点，即使在没有特权信息的情况下也达到了最先进的性能。值得注意的是，剪枝……
tldr: WISD方法通过量化或剪枝构建原模型的弱化版本，并利用原模型与弱化模型之间的对比作为在策略自蒸馏的训练信号，无需特权信息即可将数学与编程推理任务的平均准确率提升4.0至5.5个百分点。
